description: Deep-audited worldwide discovery configuration. Source results are leads only and must be reviewed before publication.

api_sources.name: RecentBreaches API
api_sources.polling: Cache responses for 10 minutes; no key required for public endpoint
api_sources.notes: Free JSON breach feed; records are keyword-filtered and queued for review.

api_sources.name: PenDoc Security Feed API
api_sources.notes: Open searchable security intelligence feed aggregating 40+ sources.

api_sources.name: GitHub Advisory API
api_sources.notes: Use for identity/verification SDK vulnerabilities, not as proof that a company was breached.

api_sources.name: NVD CVE API
api_sources.notes: Use for vulnerabilities in verification software dependencies; not breach proof.

api_sources.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
api_sources.notes: Use to prioritize actively exploited flaws affecting identity providers or their dependencies.

api_sources.name: OWASP Threat Intelligence API
api_sources.notes: Use to discover threats impacting identity verification implementations.

api_sources.name: XposedOrNot Breach Repository
api_sources.notes: Global breach repository and aggregate statistics; use to identify historical incidents requiring source verification.

historical_registers.name: DataBreach.com Historical Database
historical_registers.notes: Public searchable archive of historical breach incidents with breach and added dates.

historical_registers.name: FreeDatabreaches Historical Archive
historical_registers.notes: Open GitHub historical breach archive; use only as a lead source and verify against original reporting.

historical_registers.name: California AG Data Security Breach List
historical_registers.notes: Official searchable list and CSV of notices affecting 500+ California residents.

historical_registers.name: Washington State AG Breach Resource Center
Texas AG Data Security Breach Reports
Ireland Public Sector Data Breach Register
historical_registers.notes: Open dataset with breach date, department, incident and actions.

historical_registers.name: Privacy Rights Clearinghouse Chronology
historical_registers.notes: Historical dataset sourced from government notices.

historical_registers.name: Identity Theft Resource Center Breach Alert

hibp_integration.notes: If HIBP_API_KEY is configured, query HIBP breach metadata and filter identity-document-related DataClasses.

review_policy: All discoveries are written to data/pending-review.json and surfaced in a GitHub issue. Never auto-publish a breach claim.
